purpose: Independent evidence log for critique.md; stable investigator source IDs retain their original identities and URLs.
evidence_limits: Read-only research. No downloaded code executed and no application or functional, performance, or crash-recovery tests run.
The input map contains no application repository or application caller/test paths; app compatibility is unresolved.
Current documentation URLs are unpinned unless a release/commit is explicitly recorded.

sources.title: CouchDB replication/conflict model
sources.released_version_or_commit: Apache CouchDB 3.5 stable documentation; stable URL, not commit-pinned
sources.locator: §2.3.1–2.3.4, especially revision trees, GET winner, conflicts=true/open_revs, compaction and pruning
sources.observed_operation: Opened official documentation directly and read conflict and history sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Offline conflicting revisions coexist; ordinary GET returns deterministic winner only; conflict leaves require explicit retrieval; compaction discards non-leaf bodies and pruning bounds history.
sources.applicability: Supports Pouch/Couch alternative limitations and the need for explicit review/retention; not app-specific.

sources.title: PouchDB replication guide
sources.released_version_or_commit: Official current guide; unversioned and not package-pinned
sources.locator: Live retry section and local-to-local replication examples
sources.observed_operation: Opened official guide and inspected retry and local database examples.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Live replication stops on offline error unless retry enabled; two local PouchDB objects may replicate; adapter/runtime integration remains unverified.
sources.applicability: Supports an account-free peer/relay comparison, not the requested removable-media UX by itself.

sources.title: PouchDB conflict guide
sources.locator: Eventual conflict, _conflicts, losing revision retrieval, and immutable-delta sections
sources.observed_operation: Opened official guide and read offline branch and conflict APIs.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Concurrent offline revisions share deterministic winner; callers must enumerate/fetch losing branches; application must choose a resolution strategy.
sources.applicability: Supports conflict-review alternative and immutable operation pattern comparison.

sources.title: PouchDB attachments guide
sources.locator: Attachment storage and normal read vs attachments:true, lines 11–77
sources.observed_operation: Opened official guide and compared normal metadata-stub reads with full attachment reads.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Attachments are stored on documents; normal reads return stubs/digest while attachments:true returns full base64 payload.
sources.applicability: Supports the draft's distinction between Pouch-managed attachment bytes and external photo references.

sources.title: PouchDB IndexedDB attachment issue #8456
sources.released_version_or_commit: Issue opened 2022-02-23; closed by PR #8460 on 2022-04-05 per issue activity
sources.locator: Issue description/reproduction and issue activity; especially two-revision replication case
sources.observed_operation: Opened first-party GitHub issue and read reproduction, affected adapter, and closure trail.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: In a particular IndexedDB replication with conflicting revisions, a reference could be associated with a revision that did not carry that attachment; compaction/branch changes exposed it.
sources.applicability: Concrete candidate regression scenario for attachment lifecycle; not a general claim about every adapter.

sources.title: PouchDB attachment fix and integration test #8460
sources.released_version_or_commit: PR #8460 merged 2022-03-29; fix commit 1a30d05; test commit 705b17b
sources.locator: IndexedDB bulkDocs.js revision-attachment predicate; tests/integration/test.attachments.js test #8456 bad attachment rev after replication
sources.observed_operation: Opened official PR metadata and diff; confirmed merge date and commits, inspected code guard and integration-test source. Did not execute.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Attachment revision reference is recorded only when written revision contains that digest; test branches revisions, replicates, removes/compacts a branch, and expects stale stub fetch to fail.
sources.applicability: Issue-to-code-fix-to-regression-test evidence for an analogous risk; not validation of this proposal.

sources.title: PouchDB 7.3.0 release
sources.locator: Official releases page, 7.3.0 release notes, Bugfixes list
sources.observed_operation: Direct tag reopen returned an error in the investigator run; independently opened official releases listing and confirmed #8460 listed in 7.3.0 notes.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Release notes list #8460 attachment revision fix among 7.3.0 bug fixes.
sources.applicability: Confirms the issue fix was listed as shipped; does not establish current-version adapter suitability.

sources.title: PouchDB 8.0.0 delete semantics release note
sources.locator: Release notes, “Add purge to the indexeddb adapter,” lines 182–187
sources.observed_operation: Opened official release page and read normal remove versus purge semantics.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Normal remove creates _deleted=true revision so delete replicates; purge physically removes data and is described as administrative.
sources.applicability: Supports tombstone/purge distinction only; does not define business precedence for concurrent edit/delete.

sources.title: SQLite Session Extension introduction
sources.released_version_or_commit: Official current API documentation; extension included since 3.13.0 and disabled by default unless built with required flags
sources.locator: §1.2–1.3 and §2.1–2.3, especially primary-key limitations and changeset construction
sources.observed_operation: Opened official SQLite documentation; read enablement, key requirements, conflict, and coalescing sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Requires declared primary keys and build flags; repeated updates within a session coalesce; changesets apply to matching schema/baseline.
sources.applicability: Supports using Session Extension only as a comparison/patch transport, not as readable per-edit history.

sources.title: SQLite Session C interface
sources.released_version_or_commit: Official current C API reference; deployed behavior depends on bundled SQLite version
sources.locator: Patchset semantics, DATA conflict detection, changeset apply callbacks, and experimental rebaser/apply APIs
sources.observed_operation: Opened official API reference and inspected patchset and rebase details.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Patchsets omit original values and cannot report DATA conflicts; relevant apply/rebase APIs are documented as experimental.
sources.applicability: Supports the draft's warning that application-authored conflict policy is required.

sources.title: SQLite Atomic Commit and crash tests
sources.released_version_or_commit: Official live technical documentation; not release-pinned
sources.locator: §8 crash tests and §9 platform caveats, lines 405–438
sources.observed_operation: Opened official technical documentation and read crash-test and caveat sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Modified VFS simulates incomplete/out-of-order writes and verifies all-or-none reopen; correctness depends on filesystem locks, flush/fsync, hardware, and platform assumptions.
sources.applicability: Supports proposed target-platform failure tests, not a guarantee for the survey app.

sources.title: Automerge conflict API
sources.locator: Same-property conflict, getConflicts, later assignment, and operation-ID ordering, lines 60–112
sources.observed_operation: Opened official docs and read conflict example and operation ordering.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Different properties combine; same-property concurrent values are retained behind deterministic default read; getConflicts reveals them; later assignment clears conflict; ordering uses operation ID rather than wall-clock time.
sources.applicability: Supports Automerge as a candidate only with explicit conflict exposure and retention.

sources.title: Automerge merge rules
sources.locator: Map merge rules, lines 62–74
sources.observed_operation: Opened official under-the-hood doc and read the concurrent map set/delete rules.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Concurrent deletion of map key x with a set of x yields the set value in the merged map.
sources.applicability: Supports the draft's warning not to encode record deletion as removal of a map key.

sources.title: Automerge Repo storage and compaction
sources.locator: Concurrent local storage and compaction, lines 74–108
sources.observed_operation: Opened official storage documentation and read concurrent-compaction behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Storage reload merges stored changes; compaction removes changes incorporated into that snapshot while accounting for changes loaded by a process.
sources.applicability: Supports checking a pinned desktop binding and archive-retention policy before adoption.

sources.title: RxDB replication engine
sources.locator: Offline replication and conflict handling, especially lines 57–67 and 141–157
sources.observed_operation: Opened docs and inspected backend, offline, checkpoint, and conflict-handler sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Custom backend can implement push/pull; offline local edits resume; default conflict handler drops fork state in favor of master, while custom handler is configurable.
sources.applicability: Supports the draft's requirement for a loss-preserving custom handler/backend and its note that this does not provide manual-file UX.
